batch_policy: Groups of at most eight distinct sample records within target and orientation; preserve deterministic source chunk order. Retain group membership for every request and retry.
cache_policy: Deduplicate exact field evidence and retain its first recorded batch context. Save every full batch and field mapping. Never mix single-field and batch labels.
comparison: Exact single-field GLM-5.2 on both vendors for all96frozen contest audit responses, 192fields. Unchanged-name batch repeats on those192fields.
limitations: Assistant calibration references are not human gold.
Batch interaction context differs from the historical single-field judge.
Production audit disagreements and unknowns must remain visible.
primary_labels: Agreement of original and exchanged judge-name views, otherwise unknown.
selection: Only passing candidate among the two phases; no thresholds relaxed.
